description: The bar chart, titled "Accuracy (%)", illustrates the performance of three models—CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—measured by accuracy in percentage, with a secondary metric of token count displayed on the right vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the three models, each represented by a distinct color: CoD is shown in red, CCoT in light blue, and CoUT in green. The left vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, while the right vertical axis, labeled "Token Count", ranges from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. Each model has a corresponding bar, with the height of the bar indicating its accuracy and the value on top of the bar showing the token count. For CoD, the accuracy is 91.19% with a token count of 676.85. For CCoT, the accuracy is 88.50% with a token count of 534.24. For CoUT, the accuracy is 88.40% with a token count of 445.91. The chart also includes a red bar with a value of 80.89 and a token count of 354.46, which is not explicitly labeled in the legend but appears to be associated with the CoD model. The bars are arranged in descending order of accuracy, with CoD having the highest accuracy and the red bar associated with CoD having the highest token count. The chart does not provide a legend for the red bar with the value of 80.89, which may represent a different model or a different condition.
